summary: Keep a published bounded agents roster readable while a graph-preserving trim moves its rows into retention and while a replacement page order is still waiting for its cards. Read page order and cards atomically, and select a replacement only when both halves are available.

replay.detail: Full projection replacement still invalidates publications.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol or generated code changes.

downtime.detail: Graph-equivalent bounded roster publications remain available during refolding.
